description: Skip job matches the user does not want, so they stop showing in the user's matches. Pass 1 to 25 job_match_ids from getmattered_get_matches and, optionally, reason: not_interested, wrong_location, too_senior, too_junior, salary_too_low, wrong_role, company_mismatch, already_applied or other. The reason is saved with the skip and used to improve this user's future matches. Nothing is sent to any employer and nothing is spent. It can be undone with getmattered_restore_matches while the posting is still open. Skip only the matches the user turned down. Do not use it to reject an application that is waiting for review; use getmattered_reject_applications. Next: getmattered_get_matches for the next matches.

job_match_ids.description: Job match ids from getmattered_get_matches, 1 to 25 (e.g. [48213, 48214]).

reason.description: Why the user skipped them, so the matcher learns (e.g. "too_senior").

name: getmattered_skip_matches

action.description: The operation that ran: save, skip, unsave or restore.

title: Skip Job Matches
